tools.name: luma_get_api_key
tools.description: Return the details of the calendar API key in use: its name, scope, calendar and last-used time. Good first call to confirm the key works. Luma API: GET /v1/api-keys/get-self.

tools.name: luma_get_calendar
tools.description: Return the calendar that the API key manages: name, slug, launch status and settings. Luma API: GET /v1/calendars/get.

tools.name: luma_list_calendar_events
tools.description: List the events on the calendar, approved by default, with upcoming or past filters and cursor paging. Set status to pending to see submissions waiting for approval. Luma API: GET /v1/calendars/events/list.

tools.name: luma_lookup_event
tools.description: Find an event by its Luma event_id or by its lu.ma / luma.com URL. Luma API: GET /v1/calendars/events/lookup.

tools.name: luma_get_event
tools.description: Return one event's full details, for an event you manage or can see. Luma API: GET /v1/events/get.

tools.name: luma_list_guests
tools.description: List the guests registered for an event, optionally filtered by approval status, with cursor paging. Luma API: GET /v1/events/guests/list.

tools.name: luma_get_guest
tools.description: Return one guest's registration, status, tickets and check-in state for an event. Luma API: GET /v1/events/guests/get.

tools.name: luma_list_ticket_types
tools.description: List the ticket types of an event. Set include_hidden to true to add hidden ticket types. Luma API: GET /v1/events/ticket-types/list.

tools.name: luma_get_ticket_type
tools.description: Return one ticket type by its id. Luma API: GET /v1/events/ticket-types/get.

tools.name: luma_list_event_coupons
tools.description: List the discount coupons that apply to one event. Luma API: GET /v1/events/coupons/list.

tools.name: luma_list_calendar_coupons
tools.description: List the discount coupons of the calendar. Luma API: GET /v1/calendars/coupons/list.

tools.name: luma_list_blasts
tools.description: List the email blasts sent to the guests of one event. Luma API: GET /v1/events/blasts/list.

tools.name: luma_get_blast
tools.description: Return one email blast with its subject, body and send status. Luma API: GET /v1/events/blasts/get.

tools.name: luma_list_contacts
tools.description: Search the calendar's audience by name or email, filter by contact tags or membership status, and sort by activity. Luma API: GET /v1/calendars/contacts/list.

tools.name: luma_list_contact_tags
tools.description: List the contact tags defined on the calendar. Luma API: GET /v1/calendars/contact-tags/list.

tools.name: luma_list_event_tags
tools.description: List the event tags defined on the calendar. Luma API: GET /v1/calendars/event-tags/list.

tools.name: luma_list_calendar_admins
tools.description: List the admins of the calendar. Luma API: GET /v1/calendars/admins/list.

tools.name: luma_list_membership_tiers
tools.description: List the membership tiers of the calendar. Luma API: GET /v1/memberships/tiers/list.

tools.name: luma_list_webhooks
tools.description: List the webhooks registered for the account. Luma API: GET /v1/webhooks/list.

tools.name: luma_search_places
tools.description: Search for a venue or address by text. Luma API: GET /v1/places/search.

tools.name: luma_update_guest_status
tools.description: Set a guest's status for an event: approved, declined, waitlist or pending_approval. No email is sent unless send_email is true. Luma API: POST /v1/events/guests/update-status.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: luma_lookup_event, luma_get_guest, luma_list_ticket_types, luma_get_ticket_type, luma_list_blasts, luma_get_blast, luma_list_contacts · Private data: luma_get_api_key, luma_get_calendar, luma_list_contacts, luma_list_contact_tags · Public sink: luma_list_blasts, luma_get_blast, luma_list_contacts, luma_update_guest_status.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: luma_lookup_event, luma_get_guest, luma_list_ticket_types, luma_get_ticket_type, luma_list_blasts, luma_get_blast, luma_list_contacts · Private data: luma_get_api_key, luma_get_calendar, luma_list_contacts, luma_list_contact_tags · Public sink: luma_list_blasts, luma_get_blast, luma_list_contacts, luma_update_guest_status

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
